The '''Mantan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] that contained the planet [[Mantan]].

==History==
Between [[4400 BBY|4400]] and [[4200 BBY]], [[Mantan]] was one of the first worlds colonized by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] outside their own star system.<ref name="TEA" />
